_description: Cross-SDK DCP-09 §3.5 mandate chain vectors. Every chain verifier MUST accept each must_accept chain (root first), verified at verification_time against keys (the human principal keys and each delegating agent keys by agent_id) with revoked_mandate_ids revoked, and report expected.depth and expected.effective_tier (the greatest minimum_security_tier along the chain, null when none sets one). It MUST reject each must_reject chain, at its own verification_time when it has one, with an error that contains error_contains (case-insensitive). Numeric limits compare only as integers within ±(2^53 − 1); a mandate with a numeric limit outside that range is not comparable, so some must_reject chains carry the integer 9007199254740993, which a JSON parser that reads doubles cannot represent. tier_floor gives the security tier (DCP-AI v2.0 §14.2) computeSecurityTier returns for an intent, a policy decision and a mandate chain effective tier, which can only raise the tier.
